notes: Phase 1B loading screen tips: warm, short, teen-rated, true to what the game does today. No spoilers.

tips.text: Waystones remember you. Attune one and the road home gets a little shorter.
A warm meal and a bed at the inn do more for a tired adventurer than any potion.
Every monster telegraphs its attack. Watch the shape, then move.
Slimes are gentle teachers. Start there and learn the rhythm of a fight.
Herbs and ore grow back. Walk the same path in a few days and look again.
The guild board changes with the days. Check it when you wake up.
Villagers know more than their job titles suggest. Ask them about the road.
Your map fills in as you walk. Pencil first, ink once you have seen it yourself.
Text size, flash strength and colourblind modes can be changed in Settings at any time.
If you fall, your coins wait in a lantern where it happened. Go back for it.
Handle a new material once and you may learn what it can become.
Some views deserve a picture. Photo mode lets you frame them in peace.
There is no rush. The world will still be here when you come back from supper.
Companions have opinions about how to fight. Tell them what you prefer.
A well-thrown fire bomb can turn a bad moment around. Save one for emergencies.
The game saves when you attune a waystone and after you recover. Rest easy.
